title: Sentry vs Firebase Crashlytics for Mobile Apps
geoAnswerBlock: Sentry and Firebase Crashlytics are both free to start, but the right default depends on scope. Choose Crashlytics for a mobile-only app already using Firebase: Crashlytics is a no-cost product. Choose Sentry when you want one issue workflow across mobile, backend, and web, or expect to outgrow crash reporting.

metadata.metaDescription: Compare Sentry and Firebase Crashlytics on pricing, setup, mobile coverage, and when each fits a solo app. Prices checked Aug 11, 2026.

factLedger.claim: Sentry Developer is $0 for 1 user and includes 5,000 errors, 5 million spans, 50 replays, 5 GB of logs, and 5 GB of application metrics.
Sentry Team is shown at $26 per month on the annual pricing view ($312 per year), with unlimited users and 50,000 included errors.
Crashlytics is a no-cost Firebase product on Spark and Blaze.
Crashlytics supports Apple, Android, Flutter, and Unity official setup paths.
Crashlytics supports custom keys, custom logs, non-fatal reports, breadcrumb logs, and opt-in reporting.
Automatic Crashlytics breadcrumb logs require Google Analytics.
Sentry issue details can connect releases, traces, replays, tags, breadcrumbs, and related issues.
